name: Tyro: Legend of Whisperwood
storyline:
Tyro: Legend of Whisperwood is a harrowing Souls-like Metroidvania where the world crumbles as your mind fractures. You are Tyro, a determined field mouse wielding more pain than power—haunted by loss, driven by vengeance.

The once-lush realm of Whisperwood rots under the grip of the Gladeblight, a corruption that twists creatures into unspeakable horrors. But the infection runs deeper than flesh—it seeps into thought, memory, and reality itself.

Every scar, every choice, every moment of fear chips away at Tyro’s grip on sanity. And as the Sanity Gauge drains, so does the world’s stability. Hallucinations become real. Time slips. Enemies change. The map shifts beneath your feet.

You don't just fight monsters.
You fight your own mind.
summary: Play as Tyro, a vengeful field mouse, in this early alpha slice of our consequence-based metroidvania. Explore a hand-drawn 2D world, collect power-ups, battle challenging bosses, discover hidden lore, and experience voice-acted dialogue that brings Whisperwood to life.
